name: Mesu Dorei no Tane
source:
A fan-fiction novel of GUNDAM SEED and DESTINY.
The horny babes seduce the crews with their heavenly bodies.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE019258.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
一部以《机动战士高达SEED》与《机动战士高达SEED DESTINY》为题材的同人小说。
淫荡的美女们用令人销魂的肉体诱惑着众多舰员。

[引自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE019258.html]DLsite英文站[/url]]
